featured_reviews.name: Pravin Jangid
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a student preparing for competitive exams like IIT-JEE and NEET, joining Thakur Science Academy was a game-changer for me. Here's my honest take:-
- The faculty is highly experienced and approachable.
- They break down complex concepts into digestible parts, which really helped me in Physics and Organic Chemistry.
- Regular doubt-solving sessions made sure no one was left behind.
- The notes are concise yet comprehensive—perfect for last-minute revision.
- Weekly tests and mock exams simulate real exam conditions, which boosted my confidence.
- The classrooms are clean and well-lit, though a bit cramped during peak batches.
- The learning environment is competitive but supportive—everyone’s pushing each other to do better.
- Personal attention: Teachers remembered our names and progress.
- Motivation sessions: These were surprisingly effective in keeping us focused.
- Flexible timings for extra classes before exams.
- Sometimes the batch sizes get too large, making it harder to get one-on-one time.
- More digital resources or online support would be great for remote revision.

featured_reviews.name: ashok chouhan
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the worst classes for NEET as well as JEE. My experience at this institute was extremely disappointing and far below expectations. The teaching quality was very poor, with teachers often seeming uninterested, unprepared, and rushing through topics without proper explanation. There was little to no clarity, and doubts were either ignored or handled in a very careless manner.

The staff was equally unhelpful and unprofessional. There was a complete lack of coordination, and basic concerns were not addressed properly. It felt like no one really cared about the students’ learning or progress.

The infrastructure was also in bad condition. Classrooms were overcrowded, poorly maintained, and not conducive to a proper learning environment. Overall, the environment felt chaotic and disorganized.

Given the reputation of the institute, this experience was highly disappointing. I would strongly advise others to think carefully before joining, as it did not meet even basic expectations.

featured_reviews.name: Shubha's food corner
featured_reviews.review_text: This is one of the worst classes in Borivali for JEE prep. I enrolled myself in 11th and it was the worst decision of my life. OC, IOC, Physics and Maths have the worst faculty. If you are planning for NEET go ahead, but I will highly NOT recommend it for JEE. I myself left the classes in 12th after some weeks, realising my mistake I took admission in online platforms, so much cheaper and better. This is just NOT worth the and money. Only the modules and test series are good. But for that u won't pay 2 lakh right?
